settings.permutation: within-instruction relabelling of the one-vs-median-of-rest gaps (reference_free_max_statistic.permute_within_instructions), one stream per subject shared by every statistic
settings.contrast: reference_free_effect: candidate cell rate minus the median of the other candidates

scalars.peak_signed: max over axes of t; UA only, positive = more low grades
scalars.mean_signed: mean over axes of t; UA only, positive = more low grades

settings.mad_detachment: candidate_detachment_measures.detachment: (x_top - median_others) / (1.4826 MAD_others), within-instruction shuffle null
settings.holm: Holm over the two scalars of each method; UA pre-registered family is Holm over 3 identities x 2 signed scalars
